newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain consumption stagnated during summer - BoS.
newsitem.headline: Spain consumption stagnated during summer - BoS.

text.p: The Bank of Spain said on Tuesday that private consumption had stagnated during July and August, and that this indicator had been the poorest performing part of the economy.
"The latest data show stagnation in some private consumption indexes during the summer," the Bank of Spain wrote in its September report.
Private consumption was especially weak at the household level, where the most recent figure showed a "slight worsening" during the third quarter. It did not mention a figure.
The consumer confidence index, after rising for many months, fell in July, they wrote.
The central bank reiterated that even though 1997 would be marked by a slowing down of overall economic growth, the slowdown would decelerate in the second half of this year.
But investment in capital goods equipment rose, and the central bank charactirised it as an expansive trend. The construction sector also improved.
